item.title: Cabinet Approves Enhanced PLI Scheme Outlay for Semiconductor and Electronics Manufacturing
item.description: Union Cabinet chaired by Prime Minister approves additional budgetary allocation of Rs 15,000 crore under Production Linked Incentive for tech hardware.

item.title: Gross Goods and Services Tax Revenue Reaches Record High of Rs 1.95 Lakh Crore for March 2026
item.description: Ministry of Finance reports 11.5% year-on-year growth in monthly GST collections driven by robust domestic economic activity.
